Former TMC MLA Nirmal Ghosh Arrested Over RG Kar Victim's Cremation

Former Trinamool Congress MLA Nirmal Ghosh has been arrested in connection with the alleged hurried cremation of a victim from RG Kar Medical College and Hospital. The arrest is related to a rape-murder case involving a doctor from the hospital. The incident has prompted an investigation, with one report mentioning a probe ordered into the death of a former Bengal deputy speaker found at a TMC office.
